info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Economic Capital Insights API
info.description: The Economic Capital Insights API provides financial institutions with access to critical data and analytics related to economic capital modeling. This API allows users to retrieve detailed assessments of their economic capital requirements, helping them make informed risk management decisions. It serves banking professionals, financial analysts, and risk managers seeking to enhance their understanding of capital adequacy and allocate financial resources effectively. With this endpoint, organizations can better align their capital structure with regulatory expectations and improve their overall financial resilience.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of Economic Capital models available in the system, providing insights into their configurations and parameters.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve economic capital model data. It must include required parameters according to the schema defined in the components section.

GetEconomicCapitalModelsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the economic capital operations GET request in JSON format. It is expected to be a stringified value.
